steps.text: Reduce the cocoa biscuits to fine powder.
Add the melted butter and mix until you get a wet sand texture.
Pour the mixture into a tart pan or a 20 cm diameter ring. Press the bottom and edges firmly with the back of a spoon or a glass.
Place in the refrigerator for 30 minutes.
Finely chop the white chocolate and place it in a bowl.
Heat the cream until it simmers, then pour it over the chocolate. Mix gently from the center outward until you get a perfectly smooth ganache.
Pour the ganache over the cold biscuit base.
Place in the refrigerator for 45 minutes to 1 hour, until the surface is firm enough to receive the next layer.
Chop the milk chocolate and place it in a bowl.
Bring the cream to a simmer then pour it over the chocolate. Let rest for 1 minute then mix until you get a smooth and shiny texture.
Gently pour this ganache over the well-set white chocolate layer.
Place again in the refrigerator for 45 minutes to 1 hour.
Chop the dark chocolate and place it in a bowl.
Heat the cream until it simmers then pour it over the chocolate.
Gently pour over the milk chocolate layer.
